concerns.text: The baseline model uses elemental CTE values retrieved from the Materials Project (DFT‑derived) to compare against experimental CTE measurements in the curated dataset. Mixing DFT‑derived elemental references with experimental alloy CTEs may introduce a systematic bias, potentially inflating or deflating ΔR² and compromising the validity of SC‑001. Recommend either (a) sourcing elemental CTEs from an experimental database (e.g., NIST) for a like‑for‑like comparison, or (b) explicitly acknowledging and quantifying this source‑type mismatch as a confound in the analysis.
